bank_name: Engineers Day 2026 Debugging Arena - JavaScript Problem Bank

problems.title: Sum of Positive Numbers
problems.problem_statement: Read N integers and print the sum of all positive numbers.
problems.input_format: First line contains N. Second line contains N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the sum of all positive integers.

bugs.description: The condition selects negative numbers instead of positive numbers.
bugs.why_wrong: The task requires adding values greater than zero.

problems.title: Largest of Three
problems.problem_statement: Read three integers and print the largest value.

bugs.description: The program replaces largest when the third value is smaller instead of when it is larger.
bugs.why_wrong: The largest value should only be replaced when the new value is greater.

problems.title: Simple Interest
problems.problem_statement: Calculate simple interest using SI = P × R × T / 100.
problems.input_format: Three numbers: principal, rate, and time.
problems.output_format: Print simple interest with two decimal places.

bugs.description: The percentage calculation divides by 10 instead of 100.
bugs.why_wrong: A percentage rate must be converted from percent by dividing by 100.

problems.title: Print Multiples of Five
problems.problem_statement: Read N and print all numbers from 1 through N that are divisible by 5.
problems.output_format: Print matching numbers in increasing order separated by spaces.

bugs.description: The loop stops at N-1, so N itself is never checked.
bugs.why_wrong: The required range includes N.

problems.title: First Occurrence Search
problems.problem_statement: Read N integers and a target. Print the zero-based index of the first occurrence, or -1 if the target is absent.
problems.input_format: First line contains N. Second line contains N integers. Third line contains the target.
problems.output_format: Print the first zero-based index or -1.

bugs.description: The search continues after finding a match and overwrites the answer when the target appears again.
bugs.why_wrong: The problem asks for the first occurrence, so the search must stop at the first match.

problems.title: Vowel Counter
problems.problem_statement: Read a line of text and count vowels a, e, i, o, and u. Uppercase vowels must also be counted.
problems.input_format: One line containing letters and spaces.

bugs.description: The condition checks only lowercase vowels.
bugs.why_wrong: Uppercase vowels are also supposed to be counted.

problems.title: Reverse a Number
problems.problem_statement: Read a positive integer and print its digits in reverse order as a number.

bugs.description: The program prints n after the loop instead of the reversed value.
bugs.why_wrong: n has become 0 by the time the loop finishes; the calculated reversed number is stored in reversed.

problems.title: Main Diagonal Sum
problems.problem_statement: Read an N x N matrix and print the sum of its main diagonal.
problems.input_format: First line contains N, followed by N rows containing N integers.

bugs.description: The diagonal condition uses i === j + 1 instead of i === j.
bugs.why_wrong: Main diagonal elements have equal row and column indices.

problems.title: Student Result Calculator
problems.problem_statement: Read marks for five subjects. Print total, average to two decimal places, and PASS or FAIL. A student passes only if every subject mark is at least 40.
problems.input_format: One line containing five integer marks.
problems.output_format: Print total, average, and PASS or FAIL on separate lines.

bugs.description: The subject pass threshold is 35 instead of 40.
bugs.why_wrong: Every subject must have at least 40 marks.

bugs.description: The average is divided by 4 instead of 5.
bugs.why_wrong: There are five subjects.

bugs.description: The program sets passed to true when the average is at least 40, even if a subject has failed.
bugs.why_wrong: Passing requires every subject to meet the minimum mark, not merely a sufficient average.

bugs.description: The passing output is PASSED instead of PASS.
bugs.why_wrong: The required output is exactly PASS or FAIL.

problems.title: Shopping Bill
problems.problem_statement: Read three item prices. If the subtotal is at least 2000, apply a 10% discount; otherwise apply 5%. Add a fixed delivery charge of 50 after the discount. Print subtotal, discount, and final bill.
problems.output_format: Print subtotal, discount, and final bill with two decimal places on separate lines.

bugs.description: The discount rate for subtotals of at least 2000 is 5% instead of 10%.
bugs.why_wrong: The higher 10% discount applies when the subtotal is at least 2000.

bugs.description: The discount rate for subtotals below 2000 is 10% instead of 5%.
bugs.why_wrong: Subtotals below 2000 receive a 5% discount.

bugs.description: The delivery charge is subtracted from the final bill.
bugs.why_wrong: The 50 delivery charge must be added after the discount.

bugs.description: The discount is printed with zero decimal places instead of two.
bugs.why_wrong: The required output format shows monetary values with two decimal places.

problems.title: Electricity Bill
problems.problem_statement: Calculate an electricity bill. First 100 units cost 2 per unit, next 100 cost 3 per unit, and every unit above 200 costs 5 per unit. Add a fixed charge of 50.

bugs.description: The first slab is charged at 3 instead of 2 per unit.
bugs.why_wrong: The first 100 units cost 2 per unit.

bugs.description: The second slab is charged at 2 instead of 3 per unit.
bugs.why_wrong: Units 101 through 200 cost 3 per unit.

bugs.description: Units above 200 are charged at 4 instead of 5 per unit.
bugs.why_wrong: Every unit above 200 costs 5.

bugs.description: The fixed charge is 40 instead of 50.
bugs.why_wrong: The specified fixed charge is 50.

problems.title: Attendance Eligibility
problems.problem_statement: Read total classes and attended classes. Print attendance percentage to two decimal places, missed classes, and ELIGIBLE or NOT ELIGIBLE. Eligibility requires at least 75% attendance.
problems.input_format: Two integers: total classes and attended classes.
problems.output_format: Print percentage, missed classes, and status on separate lines.

bugs.description: Math.floor is applied to the ratio before multiplying by 100.
bugs.why_wrong: For example, 80/100 becomes 0 before multiplication, producing 0 instead of 80.

bugs.description: The eligibility condition uses > 75 instead of >= 75.
bugs.why_wrong: Exactly 75% attendance is eligible.

bugs.description: The NOT ELIGIBLE branch prints ELIGIBLE.
bugs.why_wrong: The else branch represents attendance below the required threshold.

bugs.description: The percentage is printed with one decimal place instead of two.
bugs.why_wrong: The required output format specifies two decimal places.
